insights.noItemsWeak: The course has no published item — enrolled students have nothing to work on.
insights.noItemsSuggest: Publish the ready units and items, or hold enrolment until the content is complete.
insights.noEnrollWeak: No students are enrolled in the course even though content is published.
insights.noEnrollSuggest: Enrol a group in the course, or link an existing group so its students can see it.
insights.progressGood: Average progress is {pct}% — a good pace across the course.
insights.progressLow: Average progress is only {pct}% — the course is struggling.
insights.activeGood: {pct}% of enrolled students were active during the period.
insights.inactiveWeak: {pct}% of enrolled students did not open any item during the period.
insights.inactiveSuggest: Send a targeted announcement to the course's students, or ask the teacher to reach out to inactive students before the week ends.
insights.completed: {count, plural, one{# student has} other{# students have}} completed the whole course.
insights.gapWeak: A {gap}-point gap between “{best}” and “{worst}” within the same course.
insights.gapSuggest: Review assignment pacing with the teacher of “{worst}”, and carry over what works in “{best}”.
insights.lowAttendSuggest: Tie absence follow-up to contacting frequently absent students before they fall behind.
insights.noSessionsSuggest: Remind teachers to record attendance on the Attendance page after every session.
insights.allNormal: The course's indicators are within the normal range — nothing calls for intervention.
